entities.name: Paolo Salvati
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paolo Salvati was an Italian figurative artist, painter, and draftsman. His landscapes are the expression of poetic art, characterized by an intense chromatic tone as a metaphorical depiction of the inner world of man.
